company.name: Hadrius
company.shortDescription: Hadrius is an AI-native compliance platform that centralizes compliance operations for financial firms.
company.description: Hadrius develops compliance management software for financial services firms that helps organizations oversee regulatory requirements through a unified platform. Its platform supports functions such as marketing review, communications archiving, trade surveillance, employee oversight, code of ethics management, and compliance program administration. The software uses artificial intelligence to automate compliance workflows, monitor communications and trading activity, and generate documentation for regulatory reviews. It is designed for broker-dealers, registered investment advisers, private funds, and compliance consulting firms that are subject to SEC and FINRA regulations. Hadrius also provides centralized tools that help organizations manage policies, supervision activities, risk monitoring, and audit records within a single system.
